WITH j AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.name jname, c.type ctype, c.uuid FROM foreign_data f JOIN cards c ON c.uuid=f.uuid WHERE f.language='Japanese' AND c.watermark='boros'),
r AS (SELECT uuid, count(*) n FROM rulings GROUP BY uuid)
SELECT j.jname, j.ctype, COALESCE(SUM(r.n),0) total FROM j LEFT JOIN r ON r.uuid=j.uuid GROUP BY j.jname, j.ctype ORDER BY 1,2
final.answer:
The query lists each boros-watermark card that has a Japanese printing. It shows the Japanese name, the English type from cards, and the total rulings across all printings of that card (0 if none). Examples: ウォジェクの護衛 (Creature — Human Soldier) has 8, ボロスのギルド門 (Land — Gate) has 4, and Hide // Seek (Instant) has 0.

SELECT jname, ctype, (SELECT count(*) FROM rulings r WHERE r.uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM j j2 WHERE j2.jname=j.jname AND j2.ctype=j.ctype)) total

WITH w AS (SELECT a.district_id, sum(t.amount) tot FROM trans t JOIN account a USING(account_id) WHERE t.type='VYDAJ' GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT a.district_id, sum(o.amount) os FROM "order" o JOIN account a USING(account_id) GROUP BY 1),
n AS (SELECT district_id, count(*) c FROM account GROUP BY 1)
SELECT split_part(d.a2,' [SYSTEM',1) district_name, d.a3 region, d.a4::bigint population, w.tot total_withdrawn,
round(w.tot::numeric/d.a4::bigint,2) per_inhabitant,
rank() OVER (ORDER BY round(w.tot::numeric/d.a4::bigint,2) DESC) rnk,
round(coalesce(o.os,0)::numeric/n.c,2) avg_standing_order_debit
FROM district d JOIN w USING(district_id) LEFT JOIN o USING(district_id) LEFT JOIN n USING(district_id)
WHERE d.a4::bigint>=100000 ORDER BY rnk

select c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, k.type card_type,
extract(year from k.issued)-extract(year from c.birth_date) age_at_issue,
coalesce(l.n,0) loans, coalesce(l.t,0) total_borrowed,
case when coalesce(l.n,0)=0 then 'Non-borrower' when extract(year from k.issued)-extract(year from c.birth_date)<30 then 'Young borrower' else 'Mature borrower' end classification,
d.a2 district_name, d.a11 avg_salary,
rank() over (partition by c.gender order by extract(year from k.issued)-extract(year from c.birth_date)) age_rank
from card k join disp p on p.disp_id=k.disp_id join client c on c.client_id=p.client_id
join district d on d.district_id=c.district_id
left join (select account_id, count(*) n, sum(amount) t from loan group by account_id) l on l.account_id=p.account_id
where k.issued>='1994-01-01' and k.issued<'1995-01-01' order by c.client_id

where cd.type='gold' and (select avg(balance) from trans t where t.account_id=a.account_id)>1000),
x as (select h.gender, di.district_id, di.a2, di.a4::bigint inh, di.a11, di.a10 from h join district di using(district_id) where di.a4::bigint>100000),
s as (select gender, count(*) n, round(avg(a11)::numeric,2) sal, round(avg(a10)::numeric,2) urb, max(inh) mx from x group by gender)
select s.gender, s.n, x.a2, x.inh, s.sal, s.urb from s join x on x.gender=s.gender and x.inh=s.mx order by s.gender desc, x.a2

with c as (

 extract(year from cd.issued)-extract(year from cl.birth_date) age, d.account_id, cl.district_id
from card cd join disp d on d.disp_id=cd.disp_id join client cl on cl.client_id=d.client_id
where cd.issued>='1994-01-01' and cd.issued<'1995-01-01'),
l as (select account_id, count(*) n, sum(amount) tot from loan group by 1)
select c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.card_type, c.age::int age_at_issue,
 coalesce(l.n,0) loans, coalesce(l.tot,0) total_borrowed,
 case when coalesce(l.n,0)>0 then case when c.age<30 then 'Young borrower' else 'Mature borrower' end else 'Non-borrower' end classification,
 di.a2 district_name, di.a11 avg_salary,
 rank() over (partition by c.gender order by c.age) age_rank
from c left join l on l.account_id=c.account_id join district di on di.district_id=c.district_id
order by c.client_id

final.sql: SELECT SUM(reputation) FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE score=10 AND tags LIKE '%<r>%')

WITH w AS (SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) tot FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id=t.account_id WHERE t.type='VYDAJ' GROUP BY a.district_id),
o AS (SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) oa, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) n FROM account a LEFT JOIN "order" o ON o.account_id=a.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id)
SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4::bigint AS population, w.tot AS total_withdrawn, ROUND(w.tot::numeric/d.a4::bigint,2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND(w.tot::numeric/d.a4::bigint,2) DESC) AS rnk,
ROUND(COALESCE(o.oa,0)::numeric/o.n,2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM district d JOIN w ON w.district_id=d.district_id JOIN o ON o.district_id=d.district_id
WHERE d.a4::bigint>=100000 ORDER BY rnk

WITH w AS (SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id=t.account_id WHERE t.type='VYDAJ' GROUP BY a.district_id),
o AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS s FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id),
so AS (SELECT a.district_id, SUM(COALESCE(o.s,0))::numeric / COUNT(*) AS avg_so FROM account a LEFT JOIN o ON o.account_id=a.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id)
SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4::bigint AS population, w.total AS total_withdrawn,
ROUND(w.total::numeric/d.a4::bigint,2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND(w.total::numeric/d.a4::bigint,2) DESC) AS rnk,
ROUND(COALESCE(so.avg_so,0),2) AS avg_standing_order_per_account
FROM district d JOIN w ON w.district_id=d.district_id LEFT JOIN so ON so.district_id=d.district_id
WHERE d.a4::bigint>=100000 ORDER BY rnk, district_name

b as (select distinct d.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date, c.type card_type, c.issued, cl.district_id, d.account_id
 from card c join disp d on d.disp_id=c.disp_id join client cl on cl.client_id=d.client_id
 where c.issued>='1994-01-01' and c.issued<'1995-01-01')
select b.client_id, b.gender, b.birth_date, b.card_type,
 extract(year from b.issued)-extract(year from b.birth_date) age_at_issue,
 coalesce(l.n,0) loans, coalesce(l.tot,0) total_borrowed,
 case when l.n>0 and extract(year from b.issued)-extract(year from b.birth_date)<30 then 'Young borrower' when l.n>0 then 'Mature borrower' else 'Non-borrower' end borrower_class,
 split_part(dt.a2,' [SYSTEM',1) district_name, dt.a11 avg_salary,
 rank() over (partition by b.gender order by extract(year from b.issued)-extract(year from b.birth_date)) age_rank
from b left join l on l.account_id=b.account_id join district dt on dt.district_id=b.district_id order by b.client_id

with fl as (
select l.loan_id,d.client_id,l.account_id,l.amount,l.duration,l.payments,l.status,rank() over(order by l.amount desc) rk
from loan l join disp d on d.account_id=l.account_id join client c on c.client_id=d.client_id),
t as (select account_id,count(*) n, coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where type='PRIJEM'),0) dep from trans group by account_id),
rg as (select a3, avg(a11) av from district group by a3),
rl as (select di.a3, count(*) cnt from loan l join account a on a.account_id=l.account_id join district di on di.district_id=a.district_id group by di.a3)
select fl.loan_id,fl.client_id,fl.amount,fl.duration,round((fl.payments*fl.duration)::numeric,2) total_pay,
round((fl.payments*fl.duration-fl.amount)::numeric,2) interest,fl.status,di.a2 district,di.a3 region,
t.n txn_count,t.dep deposits,
case when t.dep>2*fl.amount then 'High Income' when t.dep>fl.amount then 'Medium Income' else 'Low Income' end inc,
rl.cnt region_loans, round(rg.av::numeric,2) avg_sal,
date_part('year',age(date '2026-10-09',c.birth_date))::int age
from fl join client c on c.client_id=fl.client_id join account a on a.account_id=fl.account_id
join district di on di.district_id=a.district_id left join t on t.account_id=fl.account_id
join rg on rg.a3=di.a3 join rl on rl.a3=di.a3
where rk<=3 order by amount desc
